value.rationale: The collective center is an experimentally interpretable observable of the original interacting active gas, for which individual marginals are difficult. This finding provides the complete N>=3 location/phase threshold of its many-state caustics and exact asymmetric peak strengths, independent of arbitrarily strong repulsion. The critical edge/interior distinction and precise amplitudes are nontrivial finite-size quantitative predictions; not a routine parameter substitution or isolated small-N arithmetic example. Scientific boundaries include independently flipping symmetric propulsion and zero thermal noise.
